ST-04.title: R-Multiple Distribution Report
ST-04.notes: Backend (3633150): AnalyticsService.calculate_r_multiple_distribution(), GET /analytics/r-multiple-distribution. Formula: R=(exit_price-entry_price)/(entry_price-initial_stop_price). 7 buckets, median_r, pct_above_1r, avg_winner_r, avg_loser_r. Min 5 qualifying trades. Frontend (3633150): RMultipleDistributionBackend.js — bar chart (green positive, red negative), 4-stat summary row. Integrated into PerformanceAnalytics.js §16. openapi.yaml: /analytics/r-multiple-distribution path. base44Client.js: api.analytics.rMultipleDistribution(). Hard rule confirmed: no client-side R computation in §16. No canonical spec deviations. All AC met. QA sign-off: Pass (2026-03-13).
